arguments.command:
cat > /app/tmp/t/test_proto5.py <<'PYEOF'
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, "/app/tmp/t")
from harness import *

ok = True
def A0(frames, pn=0, t=1, auth=True, size=1200, level="A"):
    return [key(0,"A","install"), dg(t,size,[pkt(level,pn,auth,frames)])]

# ---- RESET_STREAM
ok &= check("reset basic", CFG(), A0([RST(0,10)]),
    RES("t",[pres(1,0,"accepted","OK",1)], conn_open(1), KEYS(a="live"), 10,
        [st(0,10,10,True,False,"")], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# reset after data: delivered bytes retained, no further delivery
ok &= check("reset after data", CFG(), A0([STR(0,0,"6162",False),RST(0,10)]),
    RES("t",[pres(1,0,"accepted","OK",1)], conn_open(1), KEYS(a="live"), 10,
        [st(0,10,10,True,False,"6162")], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# repeated matching resets valid
ok &= check("repeated reset", CFG(), A0([RST(0,10),RST(0,10)]),
    RES("t",[pres(1,0,"accepted","OK",1)], conn_open(1), KEYS(a="live"), 10,
        [st(0,10,10,True,False,"")], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# reset mismatch with existing final_size (from fin)
ok &= check("reset mismatch fin", CFG(), A0([STR(0,0,"6162",True),RST(0,3)]),
    RES("t",[pres(1,0,"error","FINAL_SIZE_ERROR",1,1)],
        conn_closed("FINAL_SIZE_ERROR",1,src(1,0,1)), KEYS(a="live"), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# reset matching final_size from fin
ok &= check("reset match fin", CFG(), A0([STR(0,0,"6162",True),RST(0,2)]),
    RES("t",[pres(1,0,"accepted","OK",1)], conn_open(1), KEYS(a="live"), 2,
        [st(0,2,2,True,False,"6162")], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# reset below highest
ok &= check("reset below highest", CFG(), A0([STR(0,0,"61626364",False),RST(0,3)]),
    RES("t",[pres(1,0,"error","FINAL_SIZE_ERROR",1,1)],
        conn_closed("FINAL_SIZE_ERROR",1,src(1,0,1)), KEYS(a="live"), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# reset above highest: highest grows (missing bytes counted)
ok &= check("reset above highest", CFG(), A0([STR(0,0,"6162",False),RST(0,10)]),
    RES("t",[pres(1,0,"accepted","OK",1)], conn_open(1), KEYS(a="live"), 10,
        [st(0,10,10,True,False,"6162")], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# reset flow control: final_size > max_stream_data
ok &= check("reset flow stream", CFG(max_stream_data=4), A0([RST(0,5)]),
    RES("t",[pres(1,0,"error","FLOW_CONTROL_ERROR",1,0)],
        conn_closed("FLOW_CONTROL_ERROR",1,src(1,0,0)), KEYS(a="live"), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
ok &= check("reset flow stream exact", CFG(max_stream_data=4), A0([RST(0,4)]),
    RES("t",[pres(1,0,"accepted","OK",1)], conn_open(1), KEYS(a="live"), 4,
        [st(0,4,4,True,False,"")], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# reset connection flow control
ok &= check("reset flow conn", CFG(max_data=4, max_stream_data=32), A0([STR(0,0,"6162",False),RST(4,5)]),
    RES("t",[pres(1,0,"error","FLOW_CONTROL_ERROR",1,1)],
        conn_closed("FLOW_CONTROL_ERROR",1,src(1,0,1)), KEYS(a="live"), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# reset direction/limit
ok &= check("reset dir", CFG(), A0([RST(1,0)]),
    RES("t",[pres(1,0,"error","STREAM_STATE_ERROR",1,0)],
        conn_closed("STREAM_STATE_ERROR",1,src(1,0,0)), KEYS(a="live"), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
ok &= check("reset limit", CFG(max_streams_uni=1), A0([RST(6,0)]),
    RES("t",[pres(1,0,"error","STREAM_LIMIT_ERROR",1,0)],
        conn_closed("STREAM_LIMIT_ERROR",1,src(1,0,0)), KEYS(a="live"), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# STREAM after reset: size/flow checks enforced, no store/deliver
ok &= check("stream after reset", CFG(overlap="reject"), A0([RST(0,10),STR(0,0,"6162",False)])),
    RES("t",[pres(1,0,"accepted","OK",1)], conn_open(1), KEYS(a="live"), 10,
        [st(0,10,10,True,False,"")], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# STREAM after reset with end > final_size still errors
ok &= check("stream after reset beyond", CFG(), A0([RST(0,10),STR(0,10,"6162",False)])),
    RES("t",[pres(1,0,"error","FINAL_SIZE_ERROR",1,1)],
        conn_closed("FINAL_SIZE_ERROR",1,src(1,0,1)), KEYS(a="live"), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# STREAM after reset with flow violation still errors
ok &= check("stream after reset flow", CFG(max_stream_data=4), A0([RST(0,4),STR(0,0,"6162636465",False)])),
    RES("t",[pres(1,0,"error","FLOW_CONTROL_ERROR",1,1)],
        conn_closed("FLOW_CONTROL_ERROR",1,src(1,0,1)), KEYS(a="live"), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# conflicting retransmission after reset is NOT checked (no byte compare)
ok &= check("no overlap check after reset", CFG(overlap="reject"), A0([STR(0,0,"6162",False),RST(0,4),STR(0,0,"ffff",False)])),
    RES("t",[pres(1,0,"accepted","OK",1)], conn_open(1), KEYS(a="live"), 4,
        [st(0,4,4,True,False,"6162")], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# fin STREAM after reset with matching final size ok
ok &= check("fin after reset ok", CFG(), A0([RST(0,4),STR(0,4,"",True)])),
    RES("t",[pres(1,0,"accepted","OK",1)], conn_open(1), KEYS(a="live"), 4,
        [st(0,4,4,True,False,"")], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# fin STREAM after reset with different final size errors
ok &= check("fin after reset mismatch", CFG(), A0([RST(0,4),STR(0,2,"",True)])),
    RES("t",[pres(1,0,"error","FINAL_SIZE_ERROR",1,1)],
        conn_closed("FINAL_SIZE_ERROR",1,src(1,0,1)), KEYS(a="live"), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))

# ---- STOP_SENDING
ok &= check("stop basic", CFG(), A0([STOP(0)]),
    RES("t",[pres(1,0,"accepted","OK",1)], conn_open(1), KEYS(a="live"), 0,
        [st(0,0,None,False,True,"")], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
ok &= check("stop uni invalid", CFG(), A0([STOP(2)]),
    RES("t",[pres(1,0,"error","STREAM_STATE_ERROR",1,0)],
        conn_closed("STREAM_STATE_ERROR",1,src(1,0,0)), KEYS(a="live"), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
ok &= check("stop limit", CFG(max_streams_bidi=1), A0([STOP(4)]),
    RES("t",[pres(1,0,"error","STREAM_LIMIT_ERROR",1,0)],
        conn_closed("STREAM_LIMIT_ERROR",1,src(1,0,0)), KEYS(a="live"), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# STOP does not suppress receiving STREAM bytes
ok &= check("stop then stream", CFG(), A0([STOP(0),STR(0,0,"6162",False)])),
    RES("t",[pres(1,0,"accepted","OK",1)], conn_open(1), KEYS(a="live"), 2,
        [st(0,2,None,False,True,"6162")], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# STOP does not change highest
ok &= check("stop no highest change", CFG(), A0([STR(0,0,"6162",False),STOP(0)])),
    RES("t",[pres(1,0,"accepted","OK",1)], conn_open(1), KEYS(a="live"), 2,
        [st(0,2,None,False,True,"6162")], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))

# ---- overlap policies on streams
ok &= check("stream overlap reject", CFG(overlap="reject"), A0([STR(0,0,"6162",False),STR(0,1,"ff",False)]),
    RES("t",[pres(1,0,"error","PROTOCOL_VIOLATION",1,1)],
        conn_closed("PROTOCOL_VIOLATION",1,src(1,0,1)), KEYS(a="live"), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
ok &= check("stream overlap identical", CFG(overlap="reject"), A0([STR(0,0,"6162",False),STR(0,1,"62ff",False)]),
    RES("t",[pres(1,0,"accepted","OK",1)], conn_open(1), KEYS(a="live"), 3,
        [st(0,3,None,False,False,"6162ff")], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
ok &= check("stream overlap first", CFG(overlap="first"), A0([STR(0,0,"6162",False),STR(0,1,"ff63",False)]),
    RES("t",[pres(1,0,"accepted","OK",1)], conn_open(1), KEYS(a="live"), 3,
        [st(0,3,None,False,False,"616263")], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# overlap uses frame processing order, not pn order (delayed packet)
ok &= check("overlap frame order", CFG(overlap="reject"), [
        key(0,"A","install"),
        dg(1,1200,[pkt("A",5,True,[STR(0,0,"6162",False)])]),
        dg(2,1200,[pkt("A",1,True,[STR(0,0,"ffff",False)])])],
    RES("t",[pres(1,0,"accepted","OK",1),pres(2,0,"error","PROTOCOL_VIOLATION",2,0)],
        conn_closed("PROTOCOL_VIOLATION",2,src(2,0,0)), KEYS(a="live"), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# reassembly independent per stream
ok &= check("reassembly per stream", CFG(overlap="reject"), [
        key(0,"A","install"),
        dg(1,1200,[pkt("A",0,True,[STR(0,0,"6162",False),STR(4,0,"ffff",False)])])],
    RES("t",[pres(1,0,"accepted","OK",1)], conn_open(1), KEYS(a="live"), 4,
        [st(0,2,None,False,False,"6162"),st(4,2,None,False,False,"ffff")], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# delivery: newly contiguous prefix delivered after frame; retained for overlap checks
ok &= check("delivery out of order", CFG(), A0([STR(0,2,"6364",False),STR(0,0,"6162",False)]),
    RES("t",[pres(1,0,"accepted","OK",1)], conn_open(1), KEYS(a="live"), 4,
        [st(0,4,None,False,False,"61626364")], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
ok &= check("delivery gap", CFG(), A0([STR(0,2,"6364",False)]),
    RES("t",[pres(1,0,"accepted","OK",1)], conn_open(1), KEYS(a="live"), 4,
        [st(0,4,None,False,False,"")], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))

# ---- rollback of a failed packet (prior accepted packets stay committed)
ok &= check("rollback keeps prior", CFG(overlap="reject"), [
        key(0,"A","install"),
        dg(1,1200,[pkt("A",0,True,[STR(0,0,"6162",False)])]),
        dg(2,1200,[pkt("A",1,True,[STR(0,2,"6364",False),STR(4,0,"ff",False),UNK()])])],
    RES("t",[pres(1,0,"accepted","OK",1),pres(2,0,"error","FRAME_ENCODING_ERROR",2,2)],
        conn_closed("FRAME_ENCODING_ERROR",2,src(2,0,2)), KEYS(a="live"), 2,
        [st(0,2,None,False,False,"6162")], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# rollback removes stream created in the failing packet
ok &= check("rollback removes new stream", CFG(), A0([STR(4,0,"6162",False),UNK()]) if False else [key(0,"A","install"),dg(1,1200,[pkt("A",0,True,[STR(0,0,"6162",False)])]),dg(2,1200,[pkt("A",1,True,[STR(4,0,"6162",False),UNK()])])],
    RES("t",[pres(1,0,"accepted","OK",1),pres(2,0,"error","FRAME_ENCODING_ERROR",2,1)],
        conn_closed("FRAME_ENCODING_ERROR",2,src(2,0,1)), KEYS(a="live"), 2,
        [st(0,2,None,False,False,"6162")], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# rollback restores flow accounting and STOP flags
ok &= check("rollback stop flag", CFG(), [key(0,"A","install"),
        dg(1,1200,[pkt("A",0,True,[STOP(4),UNK()])])],
    RES("t",[pres(1,0,"error","FRAME_ENCODING_ERROR",1,1)],
        conn_closed("FRAME_ENCODING_ERROR",1,src(1,0,1)), KEYS(a="live"), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# rollback restores delivered bytes/contiguous
ok &= check("rollback delivered", CFG(), [key(0,"A","install"),
        dg(1,1200,[pkt("A",0,True,[STR(0,0,"6162",False),UNK()])])],
    RES("t",[pres(1,0,"error","FRAME_ENCODING_ERROR",1,1)],
        conn_closed("FRAME_ENCODING_ERROR",1,src(1,0,1)), KEYS(a="live"), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# rollback of multi-chunk store spanning offsets
ok &= check("rollback big store", CFG(max_stream_data=65536, max_data=4611686018427387903), [key(0,"A","install"),
        dg(1,1200,[pkt("A",0,True,[STR(0,0,"ab"*600,False),UNK()])])],
    RES("t",[pres(1,0,"error","FRAME_ENCODING_ERROR",1,1)],
        conn_closed("FRAME_ENCODING_ERROR",1,src(1,0,1)), KEYS(a="live"), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# two frames on same stream in one packet: second fails, first rolled back
ok &= check("rollback same stream", CFG(), A0([STR(0,0,"6162",False),STR(0,2,"6364",True),RST(0,1)])),
    RES("t",[pres(1,0,"error","FINAL_SIZE_ERROR",1,2)],
        conn_closed("FINAL_SIZE_ERROR",1,src(1,0,2)), KEYS(a="live"), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))

print("ALL PASS" if ok else "SOME FAILED")
PYEOF
cd /app/tmp/t && python3 test_proto5.py 2>&1 | grep -E "FAIL|ALL PASS|SOME FAILED" -A2
